Name: Beta Farm Planner - Seasonal Calendar and Year Overview
Author: betacalendars
Description:
[size=5][b]BETA FARM PLANNER[/b][/size]

[b]OVERVIEW[/b]
Beta Farm Planner is an offline planning menu for Stardew Valley. It puts the current day, the next few weeks, a complete 28-day season, and the full 112-day year into one place. The planner brings together dates from the game’s festival and character data, crop planting estimates, and reminders you create for your own farm. Press P by default after loading a save.

The mod is intended to make long-range farm planning easier to read without changing the game’s calendar, pausing the world permanently, or rewriting player save structures. It uses regular SMAPI events, game data, and a custom menu.

[b]WHY THIS PLANNER EXISTS[/b]
Stardew Valley’s calendar gives useful season-by-season information, while many farm decisions span more than one season. It can be helpful to see an upcoming birthday beside a crop’s last safe planting date, or to scan an entire year before choosing when to gather materials or schedule a personal goal. Beta Farm Planner combines those views and lets you keep private, save-specific notes alongside them.

This first version focuses on a functional calendar and planning core. It does not automate farming or make changes to crops, inventory, relationships, or the world.

[b]TODAY VIEW[/b]
The Today tab shows the current in-game date, the number of days remaining in the season, and events or reminders scheduled for that date. It also shows a deterministic planning-pressure label to help you spot a crowded day. Festivals, birthdays, reminders, and crop deadlines contribute fixed points; the label is a simple summary, not a prediction or an AI-generated recommendation. The scoring is explained below so it is easy to understand.

[b]UPCOMING TIMELINE[/b]
The Timeline tab presents the next 7, 14, or 28 in-game days. Choose the length from the menu. Select a date to open its details and use it as the target for a reminder. The timeline follows game dates across season and year boundaries.

[b]SEASON CALENDAR[/b]
The Season tab lays out all 28 days of a season. Markers identify festival dates, character birthdays, your reminders, and available crop deadlines. Navigation controls move through seasons and years, and choosing a day lets you inspect its scheduled items.

[b]112-DAY YEAR OVERVIEW[/b]
The Year tab presents Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter together as 112 selectable days. It gives a compact way to compare dates and season transitions without opening four separate views. Selecting a day updates the details shown below the calendar. The calendar uses Stardew’s four-season, 28-day year model.

[b]FESTIVALS AND BIRTHDAYS[/b]
Festival dates are read from the game’s festival date data. Birthday markers are read from character data and use localized character names when the game provides them. The mod requests current and following year entries to support planning beyond Winter 28. If another mod changes these data assets, the planner uses the data exposed by the game at runtime. Entries without valid dates are skipped safely.

[b]CUSTOM REMINDERS[/b]
Create reminders from the Reminders tab after selecting a date in the timeline, season, or year view. Add a short title with the game’s native name-entry screen. Choose one of four recurrence patterns: once, every seven game days, on the same day number of each season, or on the same season and day each year. Select a reminder and use Remove selected when you no longer need it.

Reminders are stored with SMAPI’s per-save data API under this mod’s own key. They are not written into the game’s important farmer or world structures. Switching saves keeps each save’s reminder list separate. If the mod is removed, the base game remains untouched; the mod-owned reminders will not be available while the mod is absent.

[b]CROP DEADLINE ESTIMATES[/b]
The Crops tab reads crop definitions from the game’s Data/Crops asset, including compatible modded crop entries that follow the game’s data schema. It sums the configured growth phases and checks the crop’s allowed seasons day by day. The result reports a latest safe planting date in the current season and an expected first harvest date when the available information supports that estimate. Crops that cannot mature before an unavailable season or have invalid growth data are omitted rather than assigned a misleading date. A multi-season crop can mature across a season boundary when its data lists both seasons.

These estimates are deliberately basic. They do not model fertilizer, the Agriculturist profession, paddy adjacency, location-specific planting rules, regrowth harvest timing, or custom mechanics that alter growth duration. They do not guarantee that a crop can be planted or harvested at a particular location. Check the crop’s in-game data and conditions before committing valuable seeds.

[b]PLANNING PRESSURE[/b]
The Today label is calculated from visible items: a festival is 3 points, a birthday is 2, a reminder is 1, and a crop deadline due today is 1. Scores of 0–1 show LOW, 2–3 NORMAL, 4–6 BUSY, and 7 or more CRITICAL. The weights are fixed and transparent. This feature does not use machine learning, access online services, or assess your play style.

[b]CONTROLS[/b]
[list]
[*]Press P to open the planner by default. Change the key through the mod’s config.json file.
[*]Use the tabs across the top to switch between Today, Timeline, Season, Year, Reminders, and Crops.
[*]Use the visible arrows and controls to change dates or timeline length.
[*]Select a date before adding a reminder. Select a reminder row before removing it.
[*]Close the menu with its close button or the game’s normal menu controls.
[/list]
[b]CONFIGURATION[/b]
SMAPI creates config.json after the first launch. OpenPlannerKey defaults to P. TimelineLength can be 7, 14, or 28. ShowBirthdays, ShowFestivals, and ShowCropDeadlines control the corresponding event markers. Changes to those settings do not alter save data. The mod does not require Generic Mod Config Menu; you can edit the configuration using the normal SMAPI configuration approach.

[b]INSTALLATION[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI for your Stardew Valley version using the official SMAPI instructions.
[*]Download the Beta Farm Planner file from the Files tab on this page.
[*]Extract the BetaFarmPlanner folder into the Stardew Valley Mods folder. The final folder should contain manifest.json and BetaFarmPlanner.dll directly inside it.
[*]Start Stardew Valley through SMAPI, load a save, and press P.
[/list]
No content pack framework or optional config menu is required. BetaCalendars.com is not required. The mod works offline after installation.

[b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]
Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or newer and SMAPI 4.4.0 or newer. No other mod is required. Use a SMAPI version compatible with the installed game version.

[b]COMPATIBILITY[/b]
Beta Farm Planner is built as a SMAPI C# mod for Stardew Valley 1.6.14 and newer. It reads the game’s festival, character, crop, and character-name data assets. Compatible mods may add or modify those assets; the planner ignores malformed entries and logs data-loading failures rather than blocking a save from loading. Modded crops with extra growth logic may not have reliable deadline estimates.

This initial release has not been manually launched inside a local Stardew Valley installation. The menu’s first-run presentation, multiplayer host/client behavior, and interactions with third-party data edits have not been runtime-tested. Please report issues with your SMAPI log and a description of the game version and relevant mods.

[b]PERFORMANCE[/b]
Calendar data is read when the save loads and at the start of each day. The menu uses the resulting in-memory event list and does not poll the game continuously. The mod adds no background threads, Harmony patches, or expensive world scans.

[b]PRIVACY[/b]
The mod makes no telemetry, analytics, advertisements, external network requests, or automatic browser openings. It collects no user data. It functions entirely offline. Reminders stay in the local game save’s SMAPI mod data. The project website is attribution and optional project information only; it is not needed for any feature.

[b]SAVE SAFETY[/b]
The mod reads game data and writes only its own reminder data through SMAPI. It does not rewrite the game’s save file, change inventory, or modify the world. If reminder data is missing or invalid, the mod handles it defensively and records a SMAPI log message. Keep normal backups of valuable saves as you would with any modded game.

[b]TROUBLESHOOTING[/b]
If P does not open the menu, check that SMAPI loaded Beta Farm Planner and that another mod or your configuration has not assigned the same key. If birthdays, festivals, or crops are missing, check whether the game or another mod has changed the relevant data asset. If the game reports an error, include the SMAPI log from the session where it occurred. Mention whether the issue concerns a specific crop, season, language, save, or other mod.

[b]BUILD VALIDATION[/b]
Beta Farm Planner v1.0.0 was compiled against Stardew Valley and SMAPI reference assemblies through an automated GitHub Actions build. The project’s automated unit tests and release-archive validation passed. The CI build uses official reference assemblies for compilation and does not redistribute game or SMAPI implementation binaries.

[b]RUNTIME VALIDATION[/b]
This initial build has not been manually runtime-tested inside a Stardew Valley installation. Compilation and automated domain tests do not replace an in-game test. If you encounter an issue, please include your SMAPI log when reporting it.
